articleBody:
Getting your website ready for the new era of AI search isn't just a trend; it's essential for staying visible. Many businesses think having a website is enough, but 'AI-ready' means something very specific. It’s about ensuring AI systems, like Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT, can easily find, understand, and cite your content. This checklist will help you quickly gauge if your site is speaking the language of AI, or if it's still stuck in yesterday's internet.

- [ ] Your website passes a technical crawl audit — why: AI systems need to be able to access and process all your content without blockages; check your robots.txt and sitemaps for issues.
- [ ] Content directly answers common customer questions — why: AI prioritizes explicit, factual answers; ensure your content is structured around real questions people ask, not just keywords.
- [ ] Your business's entities (services, locations) are clearly defined — why: AI needs to understand 'who' you are and 'what' you do consistently; avoid ambiguity in your descriptions.
- [ ] Pages use valid, rich JSON-LD structured data — why: This is how AI systems officially interpret your content; ensure your schema accurately reflects visible page content.
- [ ] Your site maintains consistent business details everywhere — why: AI verifies information by cross-referencing; your name, address, and phone (NAP) and service descriptions should match across platforms.
- [ ] The website renders quickly on mobile devices — why: Speed is a ranking factor for both users and AI crawlers; slow sites get less attention and are harder to process.
- [ ] You have useful, original content that solves user problems — why: AI seeks quality and relevance; generic, thin, or AI-generated text without firsthand information gets flagged.
- [ ] Internal links clearly guide AI to important pages — why: A strong internal linking structure helps AI discover and understand the hierarchy and relationships of your content.

How to use this checklist:

Go through each item and honestly assess your website. If you're checking off most items, great! You're on the right track. If many items are unchecked, it indicates areas where your site might be struggling to gain AI visibility. Each unchecked item is an opportunity to improve. Addressing these points systematically can significantly boost your site's readiness for AI search, making it more likely to be cited and recommended by answer engines.
